c <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(qsec, wt)) 
c + stat_smooth(method = "lm") + geom_point()

On 12-06-24 04:43 PM, Manuel Sp�nola wrote:
> Dear list members,
>
> Is it posible to draw lines form the observation points to a fitted
> regression line?
>
> c <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(qsec, wt))
> c + stat_smooth(method = "lm") + geom_point()
>
> Best,

>

I can't see how to do it without running lm() outside of the ggplot
call, but it's pretty easy:

library(ggplot2)

lm1 <- lm(wt~qsec,data=mtcars)
c1 <- c + stat_smooth(method = "lm") + geom_point() +
geom_segment(data=fortify(lm1),
aes(yend=.fitted,xend=qsec))
